lessons.title: Risk Management Fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand which trading risks can be controlled, define a planned loss, and separate market uncertainty from account damage.

lessons.title: Account Risk and Risk Budget
lessons.description: Allocate risk across individual trades, open positions, daily limits, and weekly limits without exceeding the account risk budget.

lessons.title: Risk Per Trade
lessons.description: Measure how fixed-percentage risk changes account decay, losing-streak impact, and the return required to recover.

lessons.title: Stop-Loss and Structural Invalidation
lessons.description: Place the stop where the trade thesis becomes invalid, then size the position to make that structural distance affordable.

lessons.title: Position Sizing
lessons.description: Calculate shares or contracts from account risk, entry price, stop price, contract multiplier, and estimated execution cost.

lessons.title: Reward-to-Risk and R-Multiples
lessons.description: Express trade outcomes in units of initial risk, compare targets consistently, and avoid confusing a large target with a high-quality setup.

lessons.title: Win Rate, Average Win/Loss, and Expectancy
lessons.description: Combine win rate, average win, average loss, and trading costs to estimate the average outcome per trade.

lessons.title: Losing Streaks and Drawdown
lessons.description: Measure peak-to-trough decline, understand recovery requirements, and distinguish normal strategy variance from unacceptable account damage.

lessons.title: Risk of Ruin
lessons.description: Estimate how strategy expectancy, payoff, risk per trade, and sequence variance affect the probability of crossing a failure threshold.

lessons.title: Volatility and ATR-Based Risk
lessons.description: Use recent price range and Average True Range to adapt stop distance and position size when market volatility changes.

lessons.title: Gap, Slippage, Liquidity, and Execution Risk
lessons.description: Model the difference between the planned stop and the actual fill when price gaps, spreads widen, or available liquidity is insufficient.

lessons.title: Leverage and Margin Risk
lessons.description: Understand how leverage magnifies equity changes, how margin requirements constrain positions, and why buying power is not a risk limit.

lessons.title: Correlation, Concentration, and Portfolio Exposure
lessons.description: Measure how positions that share sector, market, or factor exposure can behave like one oversized trade during stress.

lessons.title: Options Risk Management
lessons.description: Compare premium risk, assignment exposure, expiration behavior, volatility sensitivity, and defined versus undefined option risk.

lessons.title: Daily and Weekly Risk Limits
lessons.description: Use hard session and weekly limits to stop adding exposure after losses, execution errors, or unfavorable market conditions.

lessons.title: Trading Risk Plan
lessons.description: Combine account limits, position sizing, execution constraints, portfolio exposure, options rules, and review triggers into one testable risk specification.
